name: 28327 · Carthage, NC
findings: ZIP 28327 (Carthage) has 48 nonprofit organizations. 17 of them (35%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is public events, listed by 14 organizations.
Hobby and sports organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (31% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 28327 (Carthage) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 28327 (Carthage) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 42% of the typical level).
